name: tokems-admin
input_evidence: file-backed fixture and live capability catalog from one approved TokEMS origin

input_files.purpose: Structured action parameters, request bodies, reasons, sensitive-read purposes, protected check-in tokens, and output-evaluation cases

output_contract: One redacted JSON object containing action, instance, organization, risk, target, operation state, verification, audit, artifacts, warnings, and rollback boundary.
rollback_boundary: Uninstall or downgrade the local package and revoke its remote connection. Remote domain changes retain their native TokEMS release, refund, invoice, user, and notification rollback rules.
